summary: Windows blocking defect: rlm_kernel._read_context opened contextPath with os.O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW (no O_BINARY), so the CRT text-mode read translated CRLF->LF and os.read length differed from os.fstat(fd).st_size, making the strict len(payload)!=st_size check reject a valid UTF-8 CRLF context file with "contextPath could not be read completely". Gate os.O_BINARY on availability so Windows reads raw bytes preserving CRLF and byte-limit; POSIX already binary, unchanged; safe-file + atomic-context limits retained.

pointers: contextPath could not be read completely
